criteria.requirement: Add Box.get_path(path, default=NO_DEFAULT), set_path(path, value) and delete_path(path) for explicit nonempty str/int segment iterables. Distinguish integer and string keys, literal dots/brackets and list indices including negatives. Reads must not invoke box_dots parsing or create default nodes; writes require existing parents, preserve Box value conversion/recast and frozen guards, and do not create arbitrary intermediate containers. Support explicit default=None only for missing keys/indexes, propagate scalar/type errors and keep existing dotted APIs unchanged.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
